pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: Swedish, 9.a3
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White playing Bxc3; plan 4 was garbled. Rewrote both (...Bxc3 bxc3 leaves an isolated a-pawn and half-open b-file; ...Ba5 alternative). Reviewer rejected a first draft claiming doubled c-pawns; fixed and re-reviewed. British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: Swedish, 9.e4
pages.notes: Plan 1 had dxe5/exf5 (impossible), plan 3 a pin on c3 to nothing, plan 4 ...dxc4 with Black's own pawn on c4. Rewrote around ...dxe4 and regaining the pawn with Ng5/Nxe4; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: Swedish, 9.e4 dxe4
pages.notes: Overview was generic; plan 1 ignored the e4-pawn; plan 3 routed the c3-knight Na2-c1-e2 for a d4 bind that does not exist. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3 around regaining e4 with Ng5/Nxe4 against the uncastled king.

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Dubov Tarrasch
pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed ...d4 into the d4-knight; now conditional; plan 4 rewritten; British spelling (Neutralise, Use, favourable, centre).

pages.name: Tarrasch Defense: Swedish Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 put a white knight on d4, occupied by White's own pawn; replaced with the e2-e4 break. Plan 4 swapped ...a6/...Rb8 for the standard ...Bb4/...Nge7; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 Be7 8.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d5-d4 into White's d4-pawn; plan 4 proposed a minority attack in an IQP structure. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 7.Bg2 Be7 8.O-O Be6
pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed ...d5-d4 into White's d4-pawn; made conditional on the c- and d-pawn exchanges; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.b3 Ne4
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed d5-d4 into White's d4-pawn; made conditional; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bf4
pages.notes: Overview said Bf4 pressures d5 (it controls e5); plan 2 had ...Qf6 through the e7-bishop and d5-d4 into a pawn; plan 3 garbled. Fixed; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD Tarrasch: 9.Bg5 c4 10.Ne5 Be6 11.Nxc6
pages.notes: Overview called c6/d5 hanging pawns (Black has c6, c4, d5); plan 1 had Ba3 with a dark-squared bishop on g5 and a4-a5 minority attack. Rewrote overview and both plans around b2-b3 and Bxf6/e2-e4 against the chain.
